subject: [PATCH RESEND 5/7] locking/selftests: add KUnit tests for lock holder tracking

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch adds 16 KUnit tests to verify the lock holder tracking functionality in Linux. The tests cover various scenarios, including locks that did not opt-in, mutex and rw_semaphore calls, downgrade_write(), cleanup.h guards, nested locks released out of order, and percpu_rwsem_release()/percpu_rwsem_acquire() hand-off. Five tests use a helper thread to hold a lock and check the count, while three cases cover what the opt-in changes besides the count. The tests are designed to ensure that task_nr_tracked_locks(current) always equals the number of opted-in locks held by the task.
